0022600156.text: The Clippers (1-4, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (3-3, on a three-game winning streak) for their sixth game of the season, with LA 14th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Pacific while Golden State sits second in the Pacific, one game back. The Clippers are 0-3 on the road and 1-1 at home, and they are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Warriors, who are 2-2 on the road and 1-1 at home, are missing Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 115-110 victory in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026.
